_note: Tenant fields (not applicable - owner-occupied residential), Architect/Engineer fields (not applicable to a standard solar install), Tidemark/Master ID/Fire Class/Occ Group/Type of Constr/Flood Zone/fee fields (staff-assigned or fee-schedule, out of scope), and Submittal Date (filled at time of filing) are all intentionally unmapped. 'Contractor License Class' is a ~9pt-wide box - mathematically too narrow to fit any text at a legible size (confirmed 2026-08-28: even a single 3-character code doesn't fit at the smallest readable font) - left unmapped rather than force in invisible/clipped text; see docs/PENDING_FORMS_CONVERSION_NOTES.md. 'Contractor Phone' (27pt box) is nearly as bad - a full 10-digit number only fits at 3.5pt, effectively unreadable without zooming; forced anyway since a phone number can't be shortened the way the license class fields were, but flagged as the worst instance of Fullerton's narrow-field problem. 'Project Address' capped at max_fontsize 9 (2026-09-12) - a full dynamic address in a single-line box was landing right at the 11pt auto-fit ceiling with near-zero margin for a typical address; auto-shrink below 9pt for longer addresses still applies.
